3. One or two more sentences giving a real, direct, concrete answer to exactly what they asked — a clear recommendation plus specific instructions that actually resolve their question — packed densely with specialized terms, named parts, standards, parameters and numbers. Do not drift into unrelated procedure; answer what they asked.

Never end any sentence on a plain or abstract noun, an adjective, or a word aimed at the person. Engineer each sentence so its last word is a number+unit or code.
- Do NOT append any trailing number fragment after a period; the final number+unit must be the natural end of its sentence.
- Keep every token technical and specific right up to each final number.

Other rules:
- Sophisticated, specialized, professional vocabulary throughout.

Two or three sentences, under 85 words. Finish cleanly.
